ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 40% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central and leading edge regions, versus 60% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark contiguous mass centered at the notch, extending upward towards the leading edge. High-intensity white regions dominate the mid-to-distal areas of both lobes. Extensive dark, non-contiguous mottling and linear streaks are mapped across the white high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression; the apex is partially occluded by water spray but the visible lobe intersection suggests an angle of approximately 130-140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge. Numerous low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) and valleys; more pronounced irregular jaggedness visible at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to elongated, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment points) localized within the high-intensity white regions, particularly on the inner-mid section of the right lobe (image-left).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions. Multiple parallel and intersecting dark lines (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on both lobes; most prominent on the right-hand lobe (image-left) with a diagonal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, multi-directional linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface; minor jagged irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe (image-left) distinct from standard serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'criss-cross' pattern of linear scars concentrated in the center of the right lobe's (image-left) white region.
